Woman Dies by Suicide After Alleged Workplace Harassment

A woman died by suicide after allegedly facing harassment at her workplace. Reports indicate she had not received any days off for four months prior to her death. She consumed poison, leading to her death. The incident has brought attention to alleged mistreatment and lack of leave for employees.
